notes.title: Conarium's spiritual successor -- OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Greetings future ODIN team members!

It's already been 3 years since we released Conarium, and today we're launching our newest title: [i]Transient[/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26494705/91df9b3d22411853b989c264bb52a08311b72097.gif[/img]

[h2]What is Transient?[/h2]
In this Lovecraftian x Cyberpunk horror adventure, you play as Randolph Carter, a hacker whose crew has bitten off more than they can chew. Use ancient rituals and the latest hacking technology to explore Carter's mysterious dreams and VR Cyber Enclaves, and uncover a terrifying truth that will tear away at your sanity. 

If that sounds a little vague to you, here's a more specific rundown of what you can expect:

[list]
[*] An immersive, original story inspired by seminal Lovecraftian and cyberpunk works.
[*] A swath of unique worlds to traverse, in a range of different realities.
[*] Puzzles in many different forms -- cyber security to hack past, games within the game, and more.
[*] An Original Soundtrack with 27 chilling tunes.
[*] A bunch of collectibles and optional lore to dive into.
[/list]

[previewyoutube=N-Jq7_OADWs;full][/previewyoutube]

If you enjoyed Conarium, and believe (like us) that a healthy dose of cyberpunk makes it that much more interesting, then Transient is for you! And during the launch week, you can [u]grab it at a 15% discount![/u]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/962630/Transient/

It's been an amazing journey to bring Transient to life, and we hope you'll enjoy playing it as much as we loved creating it!

- The Stormling Studios team

notes.title: Our New Lovecraftian Cyberpunk Thriller ‘Transient’ is Coming 2020!
notes.content:
We're very excited to reveal that the team behind [b]Conarium[/b] and the [b]Darkness Within[/b] series, now reborn as [b]Stormling Studios[/b], is currently working on a disturbingly macabre new game! With [b]Transient[/b], our signature Lovecraftian themed adventure talents are combined with futuristic, cyberpunk ingredients, resulting in a unique setting and storyline.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1137099/db4e750e2925adcfd9be17f39f2f756e80555043.jpg[/img]

https://youtu.be/BRr6gJ2Z2rI
[h1]“The Only Thing That Is Constant Is Change” ― Heraclitus[/h1]

In the distant, post-apocalyptic future, what is left of the population of mankind lives in an enclosed citadel called Domed City Providence, created to survive the harsh outside environment. In this, mankind's final refuge, Randolph Carter, a member of a notorious hacker-for-hire group called ODIN, accidentally stumbles across the terrifying truth, a truth that might tear apart his own sanity and question his very existence.

[h1][b]KEY FEATURES[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]H.P. Lovecraft meets Cyberpunk. Delve deep into an obscure dystopian world and hold firm to your consciousness while you explore enigmatic networks where change is permanent but reality is only temporary.
[*]To find out what is going on, traverse between real and artificially created worlds.
[*]Ominous but lush graphics created with Unreal Engine 4.
[*]Secrets and easter eggs.
[*]A haunting and atmospheric soundtrack.
[/list]

[h1]Join the Transient community![/h1]
[h1]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.facebook.com/transientgame]Facebook[/url]
[*][url=https://twitter.com/stormlingstd]Twitter[/url]
[*][url=https://discord.gg/YqFaQu]Discord[/url]
[/list]
[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/1137099/ad631a91fe00d9f641f6335a28de08cc5883e7c5.jpg[/img]

Gear up for the next surreal expedition. Wishlist [b]Transient[/b] now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/962630/Transient/

notes.title: Conarium Mac Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494705/89902ac88df32aa0af2978a86a3b0b3bb114cd02.jpg[/img]
Hello everyone,

We know that some of you have had issues with the Mac version of Conarium. Thanks to your efforts, we were able to identify these issues and  a new patch has been released (version 1.0.0.10). The changelog can be found below. 

Many thanks for all your support and feedback, it is greatly appreciated. 

- Surtur

[b]Changelog[/b]
[*]Reported crash issues fixed.
[*]Graphical problems fixed.
[*]Pause menu appearance problem fixed.
[*]Achievements are working on this update, but due to an ongoing compatibility issue with UE4/Metal API, Steam Overlay is not showing. We are also awaiting a fix for this matter.

notes.title: CONARIUM TO HAUNT MAC AND LINUX USERS
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494705/89902ac88df32aa0af2978a86a3b0b3bb114cd02.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone,

The Lovecraftian PC horror game Conarium is now also available for [b]Mac and Linux[/b] users. In addition, the game has received an additional update, bringing improved controller support. 

And we want to offer a giant thank you to our community, for helping us to translate the game into [b]Hungarian and Simplified Chinese[/b], you guys are the best!

The full changelog for Conarium can be found below. Be sure to keep an eye out for further Conarium news. 

- Surtur

CONARIUM v1.0.0.6
[list]
[*]Linux and MacOS platforms are supported.
[*]Hungarian and Simplified Chinese fan translations are supported.
[*]Acquiring hotspots in the game is much easier now when a controller is used.
[*]Loading screens added.
[*]Several small fixes related to level streaming. 
[/list]

notes.title: Conarium Patch 1.0.0.5 is now Available
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494705/4c39e6146b67e5dd4b043d042f99e545721cf19f.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

Today we'd like to announce our third patch addressing a couple of issues and adding a new feature to the game: Silent Mode. Once again, we would like to thank all of you for your support, feedback, and patience. 

Here is a list of changes:

[list]
[*]"Silent Mode" added. In Silent Mode, the main character avoids making any additional comments through the game in order to provide more immersion to the player.
However, puzzle difficulties are not affected by this change.
[*]An issue fixed which was causing the player jump out of map bounds while breaking the ice with the axe.
[*]Several issues fixed which were causing some map locations not being loaded when a save game is used.
[*]Notebook interface texts integrated into the pages and no longer looks like a separate layer.
[*]Mouse cursor on notebook and inventory interfaces get hidden when using a gamepad.
[/list]

If you have any questions or issues, don't hesitate to contact us either here, or at galip@zoetrope-interactive.com.

For previous patch notes, please visit this discussion:
[url]http://steamcommunity.com/app/313780/discussions/0/1354868867715381917/[/url]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494705/da64814473ee75ddeba2e90db846fa2441714e86.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Conarium Patch 1.0.0.4 Rebind those keys!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494705/89902ac88df32aa0af2978a86a3b0b3bb114cd02.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!

Today we'd like to announce our second patch, addressing several issues that have been reported by some of you. We would like to thank all of you for your support, feedback and patience. 

If you have any questions or issues, don't hesitate to let us know in the forums.

Cheers,

Surtur

Here is a list of changes:
[list]
[*]Movement keys can be customized.
[*]An issue regarding the mouse sensitivity fixed.
[*]An issue related to electrical doors fixed which was leading the player could not progress early in game.
[*]An issue fixed related to the master volume being reset during loading screens.
[*]An issue fixed related to level streaming in Beneath the Base area.
[/list]

notes.title: Conarium Patch 1.0.0.3
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26494705/89902ac88df32aa0af2978a86a3b0b3bb114cd02.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!

It's really great to read everyone's feedback on the game. 

Today we'd like to announce our first small patch adressing some of the issues already being reported.

We're still investigating/working on the issues related to movement keys being re-bindable, level streaming, inactive door hotspots, mouse sensitivity and game start-up.

If you have any questions or issues, don't hesitate to drop us a line in the forums.

Changelog:
[list]
[*]Numpad keys, page up/down, delete, insert and home keys can be assigned in game controls.
[*]Mountains of Madness book title corrected.
[*]"Grand Inquisitor" achievement now can be obtained by checking all notes through the game.
[*]Fixed a glitch causing Borderless Fullscreen settings to be reset to Fullscreen when Cancel/Right Click/Escape keys used in options menu.
[/list]
